What is new (4.12.1):
➜ SIGN IN • Google sign-in enabled: the "Sign in with Google" button now shows in the published APK (client ID configured in gradle.properties)
↺ Version 4.12.0
➜ REDESIGN • Pulsar Neon theme: cinematic synthwave — deep purple night with a perspective sunset grid, electric pink as the main color and cyan accents, renewed nebulas and neon glows across the whole app (login, home, lists, mini player and animated backgrounds)
➜ REWIND • Pulsa Rewind: your music summary (Profile → Pulsa Rewind) with Top 10, plays/time/songs, first track of the period, charts by month/day of week/hour and facts (best day, peak hour and night owl) — filters: All time / 30 days / 7 days; tapping an item plays the podium in order
➜ SIGN IN • Google sign-in: "Sign in with Google" button on the login screen — account created with your Google e-mail, securely (verified token) • Virgin suggests a song: "Virgin, suggest a song" — she recommends from your taste; "Virgin, who are you" presents her identity
➜ FIXES • Ambient sound: nature sound entrance fade fixed (used to skip a chunk); DJ recognition with a limited mic no longer overflows the buffer • Fixed MD5 in Last.fm/lyrics/telemetry (negative bytes made wrong hex — broken scrobble/lyrics/hash) • Sleep timer: "at end of track" now really stops when the track ends; turning on Repeat all turns off Repeat one; a pause that was not caused by audio focus no longer releases sound in radio mode • Mini player/flows sync on the main thread (no thread races) and update/ban dialogs no longer pop over a closed screen
↺ Version 4.11.1
➜ LOOK • Virgin feels alive: the avatar floats up and down (TAMI style) with blinking eyes, always — and dances harder in the rhythm of the music
↺ Version 4.11.0
➜ NEW • "Avatar in the middle" hero, TAMI style: the Virgin home now opens with the big avatar centered (animated Virgin/Victor, blinking and swaying), with name and status below (● Playing / ○ Ready) • Tap the middle avatar: she greets you; long-press: opens the admin ban panel (ban/unban devices) • Fix: long-press on the top avatar sometimes didn\'t register (screen content covered it) — now the avatar responds on any tab, and the ban panel works from both places
↺ Version 4.9.0
➜ NEW • New hub layout: the app opens on the Virgin home (no title bar) and navigation moves to the top as scrollable web-style tabs (Virgin · Songs · Albums · Artists · Favorites · Videos · Playlists) instead of the bottom bar • Floating mini player capsule + floating search button; the planet theme and all features are kept • Virgin/Victor Radio: your library radio now uses the current avatar name (Virgin or Victor) on the screen, card and voice lines — the stations radio stays the same • Admin panel: ban/unban devices right from the app — hidden, long-press the avatar (token login, device list and Ban/Unban)
↺ Version 4.8.4
➜ LOOK • Cyanwave theme (web version style): navy background with cyan nebulae, electric-cyan highlight, magenta/purple accents and glass cards all over the app • Space universe kept: ringed planet, moon, animated orbit rings, holographic scanner and cockpit bottom bar — now in the web colors • Settings and features untouched
↺ Version 4.8.3
➜ FIX • Home screen opens again: the Virgin tab (6th) broke the bottom bar (BottomNavigation\'s 5-item limit); now it lives in a toolbar card (home icon) and the bar works everywhere
↺ Version 4.8.2
➜ NEW • Set of the day: "Virgin, set of the day" builds a set picked just for today (changes daily, favorites first) • Dedication: "Virgin, dedicate the next one to..." — she says the dedication before the track • Library count: "Virgin, how many songs do I have" — she answers the total
↺ Version 4.8.1 • Male avatar: Virgin now has a counterpart — Victor. Switch it on the Avatar card from the home screen: the cyan-blue look and the voice change together, and each avatar has its own name (Virgin / Victor) • The "Virgin, who are you" command and the greetings now use the current avatar\'s name
↺ Version 4.8.0
➜ NEW • Virgin home in the Tami model: first tab with cards for language, voice, voice command, Virgin FM Radio, sleep, recommend, statistics and scan device, plus Party/Relax buttons — all in the spatial/futuristic look (no trivia card; that stays with the DJ host) • Voice fix: the "DJ" initials are now always spoken as a word ("djei"), without the device spelling them out
↺ Version 4.7.0 • Virgin FM Radio: new radio mode in the menu (in the Tami FM style) — shuffles all of your songs and plays non-stop, with a greeting and the top-of-the-hour time like a real radio
↺ Version 4.6.0 • Reacting Virgin: she celebrates a like, teases a skip/dislike and changes up "next" — varied replies in pt/en/es • Chained command: "Virgin, play and then pause" — two actions in one phrase • No repeats this session: songs already played stay out of the next mixes while the app is open • Sleep mix with fade-out: the CALM set plays once and the volume fades gently instead of repeating or stopping dead • "Virgin, what did I play yesterday" — she lists the tracks from the day before via history
↺ Version 4.5.0 • Space fusion (almost like Tami): ringed planet, moon and violet/magenta/cyan nebulae in the background across the whole app • Mini-player became an orbit capsule: ring around the art and the play button glowing as an energy core • Now playing screen got animated orbit rings around the album art and the play button, with a holographic scanner bar • Bottom nav in cockpit style: cyan/magenta beacons and an energy line on top • Squared-off tabs and headers with holographic grid and floating glass cards in the lists • Titles with futuristic letter spacing and capsule active tab indicator • Settings, Virginia\'s avatar and every feature kept untouched
